package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/format/formatoptions"
	"github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/format/javascript"
	"os"
	"runtime/pprof"
	"strings"
)

func decode(text string) string {
	return strings.NewReplacer(`\n`, "\n", `\r`, "\r", `\t`, "\t", `\\`, `\`).Replace(text)
}
func encode(text string) string {
	return strings.NewReplacer(`\`, `\\`, "\n", `\n`, "\r", `\r`, "\t", `\t`).Replace(text)
}
func main() {
	if path := os.Getenv("SCOUT_PPROF"); path != "" {
		f, err := os.Create(path)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if err := pprof.StartCPUProfile(f); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		defer f.Close()
		defer pprof.StopCPUProfile()
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[2])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	options := formatoptions.Default()
	options.PrintWidth = 80
	out := bufio.NewWriter(os.Stdout)
	defer out.Flush()
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
		if line == "" {
			continue
		}
		value, err := javascript.Format("statement.ts", decode(line[1:]), options, nil)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(out, "ok\t"+encode(value))
	}
}
